name: Roadblock fork
body:
Changes vs upstream.
- Compact Loot Browser window. (roughy 2/3rds of original)
- Extra options for managing raidids (remove, merge).
- New Tooltips, messages for some options.
- Optional integration with [shootyepgp](https://github.com/Road-block/shootyepgp) for GP pricelist and member GP.
- Recalc DB option, updates DB to current price list.
- Improvements to Search.
- Prevent some leaked globals and small fixes to tooltip show/hide logic.
